turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
Mostly nasal or throat itching, and severe itching in one or both eyes.
1) Do you have any of these symptoms: hives/skin rash, lip or tongue swelling, wheezing/shortness of breath, or dizziness/fainting?
I don’t know.
2) Is the itching in your eyes associated with redness and watery discharge (tearing), or is it more like pain/pressure?
It’s severe itching in one or both eyes. I don’t know whether it’s associated with redness and watery discharge (tearing), or if it’s more like pain/pressure.
3) Do you have any trouble breathing, throat tightness, or swelling of the lips/tongue?
I don’t know.
4) Any new exposure in the last few hours—new foods, medications, insect sting, or contact with a new detergent/cosmetic/animal/pollen?
I don't know.
5) Are you having nasal congestion/sneezing or a runny nose (suggesting an allergic trigger), or is it more a sore throat/fever (suggesting infection)?
I have nasal congestion or a clear runny nose, and I have a cough.
6) How long has this been going on—hours, days, or weeks?
I don’t know.
7) Is the cough dry or productive (any phlegm)? If phlegm, what color?
I don’t know.
8) Do you have fever or chills?
I don’t know.
9) Any wheezing or history of asthma/COPD?
Yes—I have asthma (or have used a bronchodilator in the past).
10) Are you currently short of breath or wheezing, or is it only itching/congestion/cough?
I don’t know.
11) Do you have any eye pain, light sensitivity, or blurred vision (as opposed to just itching)?
I don’t know.

[ABSTAIN] I can’t confidently narrow to a specific diagnosis because key discriminators are unknown (duration, presence of fever/wheezing/shortness of breath, and whether there’s eye pain/light sensitivity/blurred vision or redness/watery discharge).

[POSSIBLE] Allergic sinusitis, Acute rhinosinusitis, Bronchospasm / acute asthma exacerbation, URTI, Anaphylaxis
